messages: Ideal meteorological conditions for a swooping rooftop entrance.
Barometric pressure optimal for gravelly internal monologues.
Thunderclaps synchronized with Batman's dramatic head turns.
Alfred recommends galoshes. Batman has declined sternly.
Atmospheric gloom rating: 9.8/10. Brooding efficiency at maximum.
Cloud deck at 450 feet: Perfect backdrop for GCPD Bat-Signal projection.
Wind speed: 22 knots from northeast. Cape billow factor: Exquisite.
Visibility reduced to 50 meters. Batman considers this broad daylight.
Temperature: Chilly. Batman refuses to admit he needs a sweater.
